title: One family of easing, and a scene’s first frame fades in
summary: The site’s transitions used 48 different easing curves, many near copies of each other. Four named ones now cover 74 of those places, so a card settling, a panel opening and a chip bouncing all move the same way. A page’s 3D scene also fades in over its first frame instead of popping, and two fades that moved by the frame now move by the clock.

measured.note: Distinct easing curves 48 → 38; 74 sites on 4 tokens. Total JS unchanged (entry 160 kB).
